description: This source file defines the LuceneIndexProfileDisplayDriver class, which manages display and editing of Lucene index profiles within OrchardCore, including rendering views and updating index metadata.

classes.name: LuceneIndexProfileDisplayDriver
classes.description: A display driver for managing Lucene index profile views and editing within OrchardCore.

methods.name: Display
methods.description: Renders the summary admin view for a given IndexProfile if the provider matches Lucene.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Prepares the view models for editing a Lucene IndexProfile, including index metadata and query settings.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Handles asynchronous updates to the IndexProfile, saving metadata and query settings based on user input.
